internal_structure: بِـ governs اسم; اسم الله forms Idafah; الرحمن الرحيم are descriptors of الله
whole_phrase_function: Opening prepositional phrase in the Basmalah formula
note: Outer phrase includes the Idafah and the two descriptors; see nested spans below.

whole_phrase_function: Internal genitive construction governed by بِـ
note: Nested Idafah span inside the larger prepositional phrase.
Both descriptions relate to الله; this is a teaching grouping, not a claim that the two adjectives modify each other.

internal_structure: إِيَّاكَ = Maf‘ul Bihi Muqaddam; نَعْبُدُ = Mudari‘ with implicit subject نحن
note: إياك is Mabni in محل نصب; the case position is inferred from syntactic role, not a changing ending.

internal_structure: وَ = coordinator; إِيَّاكَ = fronted object; نَسْتَعِينُ = Mudari‘ with implicit subject نحن
note: Coordination links the second clause to the first; the whole span is larger than a word phrase.

phrase_pattern: Imperative verb with attached object pronoun
internal_structure: اهْدِ = imperative addressed to أنت; نا = attached object pronoun
note: The attached نا is the object, not the subject; the subject is implicit أنت.

internal_structure: الصراط = Mawṣuf and direct object; المستقيم = Na‘t
note: A noun phrase embedded as the object of the command.
